summary: XS Asset Management will use Riverbend Estates as the first-property blueprint, with Lorelei House in the first migration phase. Configure role-based users, Entrata-hosted websites, tracked property phone numbers, controlled real-time availability, manual lease review, MLI Select renewal caps, recurring parking/storage inventory, automated delinquency and repayment workflows, and Facilities Pro maintenance, inspection and make-ready processes. Later calls resolved several earlier open items: publish the existing privacy policy as open text; enable virtual as well as agent tours; keep notice units off the website; remove units and rentable items only after application approval; keep the conventional waitlist off; require inspection photos; use manual maintenance assignment initially; and post $50 late fees on the 3rd and 17th after migration validation.
